short_description:
Epson Expression 12000XL Photo Scanner is your gateway to professional-grade scanning, offering the reliability and performance expected from a professional photo scanner. Discover exceptional clarity in the comfort of your own space. This A3 graphics scanner ensures superior results up to A3 format, boasting an impressive 2,400 x 4,800 dpi resolution for impeccable detail and precision in every scan. With its high-precision Micro Step Drive technology, you can achieve unmatched accuracy while scanning artwork, documents, or high-resolution images. Equipped with the powerful SilverFast Ai 8.8 software, this large-format scanner gives you access to advanced image-processing tools to effortlessly perfect your scanned output.
For those seeking to digitize films and slides, the optional TPU Transparency Unit expands this scanner’s capabilities even further. This makes it a versatile solution for users who require a film and slide scanner with exceptional quality, ensuring your memories and archival materials are preserved in stunning, high-quality digital formats.
